change_summary: Preserve attachment sources while allowing distinct derived host outputs, and align host oracles with bounded existing-owner maintenance and risk-first no-write decisions.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.10 resolves the attachment-versus-native-target conflict by preserving supplied paths and putting edited host deliverables at distinct derived paths unless the user explicitly chose a native target.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; the server advertises Skill and Plugin 1.7.10 without widening authority or changing MCP schemas.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.10 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.10.

package_setup.note: The existing bounded session hook remains compatible; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 denominator and vague prompts remain unchanged; shared oracles now accept bounded maintenance or a fully read-backed canonical no-op, keep source fixtures immutable, and avoid forcing durable writes for risk-first or one-off native-edit phases.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill and package identity, attachment source preservation, bounded canonical maintenance, risk-first no-write behavior, and the unchanged host-neutral matrix denominator.
